records.reason: The default TypeScript run path owns the provider/tool/observe/revise loop, canonical turn state, failure routing, context handling and resumable snapshot.
The split continuation is reached through the same canonical run path and advances query state on success and failure.
The target is the default query entry and owns observable turn lifecycle effects.
The numeric policy is adapted to a floor-bounded durable retry context; output reduction and terminal stop are stateful and mutation-tested.

The source persists oversized output and replaces it with a reference. Actual Zyra externalization occurs in applyToolResultBudget at query-engine.ts:514, while the claimed target only creates an in-memory/snapshotted delivery. e01-mut-030 mutates budget.ts, not ToolResultRuntime.deliver.
The source flag selects per-tool persistence thresholds. The target receives an already-computed maximumCharacters value and implements no feature-flag or per-tool threshold override.
The source distinguishes persistence failure and returns original content. The target performs no persistence operation, has no persist-error union, and cannot implement this fallback.
The source supplies a model-visible cleared-content marker. The target records omitted IDs/truncation but emits no equivalent marker; the cited tests do not assert one.
The source compares two successive token deltas after at least three continuations. The target accepts only chars/limit/force/count and stores no continuation or delta tracker.
The source continues below 90% of a turn budget and returns a nudge. The target has no continue/nudge decision and only decides compaction.
The source returns continue/stop using durable continuation and delta state. The target computes a compact boolean and cannot reproduce the state machine.
The accepted leading range has the same mismatch as its split tail: no continuation count, delta tracking, completion event or nudge exists in the target.
The source atomically returns and clears pending cache edits for the next request. The target compacts messages but has no pending cache-edit slot or consume-and-clear transition.

The source derives a model window minus reserved output and supports an override. The mapped target only consumes a supplied window. Its default caller passes an empty message array, so token warning is always computed from zero tokens.
The target constructs a boundary message, summary, reinjected attachments and preserved suffix and validates message invariants.
The target compaction result records preserved message IDs and recomputes a checksum before the default loop commits the boundary.
The target records system/tool/message character counts and hashes in durable prompt lineage.
The default entry reaches model and transport owners through the claimed provider execution callback and commits request/attempt/response custody.
Provider execution records credential failure and removes a failed credential from immediate selection through cooldown/quarantine state.

The source fingerprints gateway response-header prefixes and base-URL suffixes. The target logging_module only starts/finishes spans or writes an event and contains no gateway classifier. e01-mut-026 only tests usage accounting.
Raw JSONL reading is adapted to a checksummed branch snapshot; visible role/content/order is restored and tamper rejection is tested.
The target appends parent-linked nodes with monotonic sequence through the default canonical turn path.
The target exposes a checksummed resumable projection of session status, pending effects, outbox and checkpoints.
The target serializes ordered, checksummed history with timestamps/sequence and restores it through the default run path.
Worktree-exit/UI cleanup is not an E01 runtime-state owner.
Skill discovery/prefetch belongs to a later capability runtime.
Attribution presentation is not required for E01 canonical resume custody.
Interactive verification traffic is not the default E01 credential selection/failure owner.
Agent-definition restore is outside E01 runtime-core custody.
A source feature toggle alone is not a required canonical state transition.
